caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a hinged lid, painted primarily in shades of blue with decorative patterns on the front. The chest stands on a base with scalloped edges, colored in light brown, matching the lid. The front panel features two large, arched decorative motifs, each bordered by stylized columns painted in red and tan hues. Within each arched section, floral patterns in red, brown, yellow, green, and blue are symmetrically arranged around a central tree-like figure, with birds perched on the branches. The background of the front panel is a muted blue-green, and the side panels also show a continuation of this coloration, with similar—but less detailed—column motifs. The chest has metal hardware, including a keyhole on the front and a ring handle on the side. The artist’s signature appears in red in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Pa. German Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
